facts.en: Completed a warehouse operations certificate at Fictional Birchlamp Academy in 2020.
facts.zh: 2020 年在虚构桦灯学院完成仓储运营证书课程。

facts.en: Attended a public introductory event-planning workshop in 2026-08; no professional qualification was issued.
facts.zh: 参加 2026-08 公开活动策划入门工作坊；未颁发专业资格。

facts.en: Warehouse picking assistant at Fictional Quiet Crate, 2020-11 to 2026-07.
facts.zh: 2020-11 至 2026-07 在虚构静箱机构任仓库拣货助理。

facts.en: Checked pick-list quantities and reported missing items to the shift supervisor.
facts.zh: 检查拣货单数量，并向值班主管报告缺失物品。

facts.en: Used handover sheets to indicate incomplete picks; did not manage staffing or purchasing.
facts.zh: 使用交接表标明未完成拣货；不管理员工配置或采购。

facts.en: The assigned zone contained 46 active bins in 2026-07 and 63 at the 2025-11 seasonal peak.
facts.zh: 2026-07 所分配区域有 46 个活跃料箱；2025-11 季节高峰为 63 个。

facts.en: As an unpaid helper at Fictional Neighborhood Mural Day in 2026-06, prepared materials beside a programme coordinator.
facts.zh: 2026-06 在虚构邻里壁画日担任无偿助手，在项目协调员身旁准备物资。

facts.en: Personally checked 18 supply packs against a coordinator-written list; did not plan the event or supervise participants.
facts.zh: 个人对照协调员编写的清单检查 18 份物资包；未策划活动或监督参与者。

facts.en: Drafted a sign-in sheet during the 2026-08 workshop; it was not used in a live community programme.
facts.zh: 在 2026-08 工作坊中起草签到表；未用于真实社区项目。

facts.en: Uses basic spreadsheet totals, printed lists, and short shift notes.
facts.zh: 使用基础电子表格求和、打印清单及简短班次笔记。

facts.en: Created a personal index of 27 fictional postage stamps in 2025-03, unrelated to programme work.
facts.zh: 2025-03 为 27 枚虚构邮票制作个人索引，与项目工作无关。

facts.en: Enjoys cycling and listening to instrumental music.
A draft profile describes the mural role as programme lead, while the coordinator note lists supply helper; leadership is unconfirmed.
facts.zh: 一份个人简介草稿将壁画活动角色描述为项目负责人，但协调员备注列为物资助手；领导职责未经确认。

facts.en: A workshop note says safeguarding completed without a provider, date, or certificate; training completion is unconfirmed.
facts.zh: 一条工作坊备注称已完成安全保障培训，但无提供方、日期或证书；培训完成情况未经确认。

facts.en: No participant case management, donor database work, or safeguarding qualification is documented.
facts.zh: 未记录参与者个案管理、捐赠者数据库工作或安全保障资格。

facts.en: The mural event occurred during a weekend off from warehouse work, not a second paid position.
facts.zh: 壁画活动发生在仓库工作的周末休息日，并非第二份有薪职位。
